name: kimi-quota-statusline
description: Native Kimi status with permission, effort, swarm, tasks and remaining quotas
author: guo

interface.shortDescription: Permission, model, effort, swarm, tasks and remaining quotas
interface.longDescription: Shows permission and plan modes, model and effort, swarm, context, a background task marker and current directory, followed by remaining 5h and 7d quotas. Uses mo when 7d is unavailable. No hooks, HTML server, task output access, or non-TUI requests. Task details are available through Kimi's native /tasks panel.
